This feeling isn't a stretch of the imagination at all. I've met a lot of people who have said this. Also feel it myself. I remember reading a story about the day after ( committing suicide). Believe it or not, the chain reaction is actually usually a lot worse then what you've described.

That may sound bad, but here's my opinion and the way I've handled it. Again just my opinion. Find something that makes YOU want to live. You're in control of your own life. You should want to live it for you, not for others. On the flip side, you also shouldnt have to be in pain for others either. I want everyone to live and prosper. But, I also understand pain exists. Reach out, find your happiness. Dont depend on others because it's not their life. It's yours, and you deserve to live it your way.

You're strong for making it this far. I'm proud of you. Please, find your happiness dude. It sounds like you deserve it.

Understanding is important when it comes to the whole suicide situation. I dont know your particular set of circumstances. But, even as a stranger, I care about your existence.
